shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated motifs across the top
schematic outlined creatures or motifs in low relief
justification: Both are upright slabs whose faces are organised into a repeated horizontal band across the top over a larger lower field, and both include long sinuous serpentine forms, but that is close to the limit of the correspondence. A is wholly abstract curvilinear ornament dominated by a large central interlaced disc and spiral-ended bands, while B is a figurative programme of recognisable animals — a row of heads, quadrupeds in profile, a bird — with no disc, spirals or interlace at all.
